rules.ending: Every stage declares meta.ending: a kebab-case key for its door-ending idea, prefixed with the city code (e.g. 'pat-plate-gap'). The idea must be new against MECHANICS.md's 'Door endings' list and the advice lines in src/game/levels/endings*.ts (an idea counts as used under a new name) and against every other city's endings. The allocation does not assign endings; the builder picks one and greps first.
rules.act: Every act id is '<city><slot>-<word>' (e.g. 'pat07-tempos'), new against MECHANICS.md's Acts list and every other city; one per id, never reused.
rules.slot09: Slot 09 shape 'tough': 60-90 s, 4-5 beats, 3-4 checkpoints, A2 and A3 in every beat, knowable (TROLL-BIBLE E).
rules.hwik05: A HWIK at slot 05 is also the long stage: 60-90 s, 3-4 checkpoints; shape reads 'HWIK (long 60-90 s)'.
rules.ids: 'CITY slot NN (concept)' names a stage; the concept id is the bible id and differs from the slot number in most cities.
